account: Restart each 52-week evaluation with 1000 USDT. One spot position capped at 50% of equity on entry, or cash. Retain units across consecutive selections of the same asset. Use volume-validated daily bars, 0.10% fee plus 0.10% adverse price each way and public lot sizes. Mark net of liquidation costs. Close at final Monday open.
decision: Monday open. Use Saturday close and earlier. Train only on 78 completed Monday-to-Monday weeks ending at least a full seven days before the current Monday. Train one pooled linear model across three liquid markets. Features: last 7/28/84 day log returns, 28-day daily return volatility, percentage off trailing 28-day closing high, 7-day log return relative to BTC. Standardize each feature on the training sample only. Predict the asset's next open-to-open weekly arithmetic return clipped at +/-25% for the training labels only. Ridge penalty 0.1 times training observations, unpenalized intercept. No hyperparameter tuning. Select the strongest predicted market only if 50% allocation after round-trip stressed costs implies at least 2% portfolio growth. Otherwise hold cash. Refit once per week. Store coefficients, scale, sample dates, predictions, transactions and actual outcomes.
controls: Cash and buy-and-hold equal weights BTC/ETH/SOL with 50% cash initially, no rebalancing; a control with identical exposure clocks that buys an equal-weight basket on every candidate-active week, retaining basket units across adjacent active weeks.
qualification: Both 52-week windows positive and ahead of cash and both controls; at least ten active weeks each; positive net without the strongest active weekly gain. Report compounded weekly rate, weeks hitting 2%, all costs, peak-to-trough daily equity decline and time in cash. Historical data also used by different prior research. No parameter changes or deployment based on isolated trades.
